Title: Traffic jams stretching for kilometers at the northern portal of the Gotthard Tunnel
Description: The traffic jam at the northern entrance to the Gotthard Tunnel between Erstfeld and Göschenen had grown to ten kilometers by 9 a.m. on Sunday morning. The Touring Club Switzerland (TCS) reports a wait time of up to one hour and 40 minutes.
